Name: Excalibur Scarecrow
Author: zariax13
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6x90aVX.png[/img][/center]

[size=2]Excalibur Scarecrow adds a mythical sword to Stardew Valley that combines the functions of a scarecrow and an automatic watering system.[/size]
[size=2][b]Note:[/b] This is my first mod and also my first attempt at pixel art. My native language is Spanish, so please excuse me if the English version isn't good. [/size]

[size=3][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]🗡️ [b]Crop Protection[/b] - Functions as a scarecrow within a configurable radius[/size][/*]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50306/50306-1786368411-1406980251.jpg[/img]
[*][size=2]💧 [b]Automatic Watering[/b] - Waters all nearby crop tiles every morning[/size][/*]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50306/50306-1786368372-179665102.gif[/img]
[*][size=2]🌊 [b]Animated Waves[/b] - Beautiful magical wave effects when you enter the farm[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]🌙 [b]Night Light[/b] - Emits a soft glow to illuminate your crops at night[/size][/*]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50306/50306-1786368401-1123027491.gif[/img]
[*][size=2]⚙️ [b]Fully Configurable[/b] - Adjust radius, sprite design, and wave speed[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]🎨 [b]Multiple Sprites[/b] - Choose from different sword designs[/size][/*]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50306/50306-1786371510-383434431.png[/img]
[/list]
